def transform(g):
    n=len(g); step=5; colorsep=5
    # discover separator lines
    rr=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==5 for v in row)]
    cc=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j]==5 for i in range(len(g)))]
    rstarts=[0]+[x+1 for x in rr]; rends=rr+[n]
    cstarts=[0]+[x+1 for x in cc]; cends=cc+[len(g[0])]
    colors=[]
    for a,b in zip(rstarts,rends):
        colors.append(next((v for row in g[a:b] for v in row if v not in (0,5)),0))
    # extract template from non-separator cell with greatest occupancy (pattern)
    cells=[]
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rstarts,rends)):

        cells.append((sum(v not in (0,5) for row in g[a:b] for v in row[c:d]),ri,ci,a,b,c,d))
    _,tr,tc,a,b,c,d=max(cells)
    pat=[[1 if g[i][j] not in (0,5) else 0 for j in range(c,d)] for i in range(a,b)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rstarts,rends)):
      for c,d in zip(cstarts,cends):
        for i in range(len(pat)):
          for j in range(len(pat[0])):
            out[a+i][c+j]=colors[ri] if pat[i][j] else 0
    return out
